{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"000000000000032GZCCPAJ43P3","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram kind=sequence
node Page "page / operation"
node Memory "RdfMemory (worker)"
node Store "QuadStore"
node Feed "facts feed"
node Db "host SQLite"
edge Page calls Memory "put(facts)"
edge Memory calls Store "write(batch)"
edge Store -> Feed "append batch"
edge Feed -> Store "read back"
edge Store -> Db "apply + cursor (1 tx)"
edge Store returns Memory "batch id"
edge Memory -> Memory "rules, outboxes"
edge Memory returns Page "events queued"
